question: When sizing a hot water distribution system using the loading unit method, what is the primary purpose of converting fixture units to a flow rate?
options: To determine the pipe material required
To calculate the probable simultaneous demand on the system
To establish the static pressure at each fixture
To identify the heat loss through the pipework

question: A plumber is installing a Type A air gap on a potable water supply. What is the minimum vertical distance required between the lowest point of the supply pipe and the flood level rim of the receiving vessel?
options: 1× the internal diameter of the supply pipe
2× the internal diameter of the supply pipe
25 mm regardless of pipe diameter
50 mm regardless of pipe diameter

question: Which type of trap seal loss is caused by self-siphonage in a washbasin waste pipe that is too long without adequate ventilation?
options: Induced siphonage
Compression
Evaporation
Momentum

question: In a solar thermal system, what is the primary function of the differential temperature controller (DTC)?
options: To regulate the mains cold water pressure
To prevent the collector from overheating in winter
To activate the circulation pump when the collector is hotter than the storage cylinder by a set differential
To control the mixing valve on the hot water outlet

question: What is the correct minimum gradient for a 100 mm diameter below-ground foul drainage pipe serving up to 60 dwelling units according to recommended design standards?
options: 1 in 40
1 in 80

question: A pressure reducing valve (PRV) is installed on a cold water supply. After the PRV fails open, which of the following components is most critical in preventing system over-pressurisation?
options: The float-operated valve in the cistern
The expansion vessel
The pressure relief valve set at the maximum safe working pressure
The strainer upstream of the PRV

question: Which document in Trinidad and Tobago provides the statutory framework governing plumbing installations and water use for CVQ Level II practitioners?
options: The Water and Sewerage Authority (WASA) By-Laws
The Occupational Safety and Health Act
The Environmental Management Authority Regulations
The Building Code of Standards (BCS) Chapter 7

question: When hydraulically testing a newly installed above-ground copper pipework system, what is the standard test pressure and minimum hold time before inspection?
options: 1.0× the working pressure for 30 minutes
1.5× the maximum working pressure for 1 hour
2× the maximum working pressure for 30 minutes
Static head plus 50 kPa for 15 minutes

question: In a direct unvented hot water storage system, what is the purpose of the thermally operated cut-out (temperature relief device) as distinct from the temperature and pressure relief valve?
options: It reduces water temperature during peak demand
It provides a secondary high-temperature shut-off independent of the thermostat
It equalises pressure between the cold and hot sides
It prevents backflow of hot water into the cold supply

question: A gravity primary circuit in a traditional indirect hot water system relies on thermosiphonic circulation. Which physical principle drives this flow?
options: Capillary action in small-bore pipework
Difference in density between hot and cooler water creating a convective loop
Venturi effect as water passes through the heat exchanger coil
Osmotic pressure differential across the coil wall

question: When carrying out a soundness test on a newly installed LPG installation before connection to the supply, which method and acceptance criterion is correct?
options: Pressurise to 20 mbar with air; no pressure drop over 2 minutes
Pressurise to 1.5 times working pressure with nitrogen; no drop over 60 minutes
Pressurise to working pressure with LPG; bubble test each joint
Pressurise to 50 mbar with air; pressure stabilises and holds for 1 minute with no perceptible drop over a further minute

question: What is the term for the phenomenon where negative pressure in a drain stack draws water from a trap seal, even though the fixture connected to that trap is not in use?
options: Self-siphonage
Induced siphonage
Back pressure
Compression siphonage

question: In a cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) manifold system, why must an expansion loop or bend be incorporated near each manifold connection?
options: To provide visual access for leak detection
To allow thermal expansion and contraction without imposing stress on fittings
To increase turbulence and prevent sediment build-up
To reduce the flow velocity and prevent water hammer

question: Which type of backflow prevention device offers the highest level of protection (Fluid Category 5) and incorporates two independent check valves with a middle chamber vented to atmosphere?
options: Double check valve assembly (DCV)
Pressure vacuum breaker (PVB)
Reduced pressure zone valve (RPZ)
Pipe interrupter with atmospheric vent

question: When calculating heat loss for a hot water storage vessel to determine the required insulation thickness, which formula correctly expresses the rate of heat loss (Q)?
options: Q = m × Cp × ΔT (mass × specific heat × temperature difference per hour)
Q = U × A × ΔT (overall heat transfer coefficient × surface area × temperature difference)
Q = V × ρ × L (volume × density × latent heat)
Q = P × t / η (power × time divided by efficiency)
